name: Nihal
headline: Leaving Law Behind to Tell Stories That Matter and Impact.
summary: Nihal thought law school was his only option. But his essays revealed something else — a writer's voice. Now he's studying literature and published in two journals.

name: Serah
headline: Building a Mission-Driven Career from the Ground Up.
summary: Serah came in considering an MBA. After career mapping sessions, she launched a social innovation project — and is now studying social entrepreneurship with a scholarship at University of St. Andrews.

name: Jessica
headline: Transforming Passion into Impactful Solutions.
summary: Jessica always had a flair for design. With guidance from mentors, she pivoted from graphic design to creating sustainable fashion, and she is now enrolled in a program at the Fashion Institute of Technology focusing on eco-friendly practices.

name: Amir
headline: Harnessing Technology for Social Good.
summary: Amir had a background in computer science. Inspired by a hackathon, he developed an app that connects underserved communities with local services, and he is now pursuing a degree in social impact technology at Stanford University.

name: Priya
headline: She Didn't Know What She Wanted. Until She Did.
summary: Priya came in with no clear direction and a lot of pressure from home. We didn't push a path on her — we helped her discover one. The result? A course she's passionate about at a university that fits her perfectly.

name: Maya
headline: Three Countries, One Right Choice.
summary: Maya had shortlisted universities across three countries and was completely overwhelmed. We mapped out her priorities and guided her toward the one destination that actually matched her goals — not just the rankings.
